item.title: Modern Revival of an Age-Old Industry: Re: Modern Revival of an Age-Old Industry
item.content:encoded:
You have some serious issues to work through here.

1) The poachers would be easy to determine; if they were in a show, their identities would be determined by the second commercial break. Also, whale oil hasn't been a product for over a century; it doesn't burn as clean as kerosene. I'm not sure there would be a market for it; even those looking for more eco-friendly products would have a problem using a whale-based product. The flesh, however, would be a major product, especially in Japan.

2) The other major issue is that right whales are kept an eye on. If more than a dozen or two disappeared from the same area someone would be notified and you would see a lot more than a patrol boat looking for them. You may also want to pare down the catch for another reason: Not only is it hard to harvest that much whale, but that much whale product coming to market would raise a few eyebrows. Yeahyeah I know: Pesky reality issues. But if the horror is too from reality it just stops being taken seriously.

3) The real mystery is where they got the teleportation gear from. Especially gear that works that badly. That's the question you really need to answer.

item.title: The Hinterland Division (requesting greenlight): The Hinterland Division (requesting greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article, Tale, Site Dossier, Other (It is a combination of all the previous ones using a hub page)

Elevator Pitch: The O5 council creates a new staff classification with O5 security clearance that works under direct orders of the O5 to allow them to have more staff at their disposal for operations that couldn't be told about to those with a lower security level. An agent at the Foundation is promoted to this new staff designation and is assigned to watch over an O5 level security project designed to stop end of the world scenarios from happening.

Central Narrative: In light of several new SCP discoveries that could lead to end of the world scenarios the O5 council decides that methods need to be made for dealing with problems like these, so they make a new project and promote the most reliable agent they have to a recently made position which grants him O5 level clearance. He’s assigned to spearhead the project, creating his own team and coming up with methods to then test and hopefully find the best method to deal with every SCP object or threat, reporting everything he’s doing directly to the council. There will be SCP’s referenced and it will also include several that I’m coming up with.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think that the incorporation of an character who is overseeing the files being the one who you are in the perspective of is pretty unique and different from other things on the site as they mostly don’t give the reader a character.

Additional Notes: I have not nearly finished yet so I won't be posting the sandbox pages very soon as there is still a lot to figure out in terms of the story. I just want to know if the concept is good enough that I should continue it and I want to get greenlit earlier on so I don’t have to worry about it later, I’m not sure if this will need to be split into several drafts since the pages will inevitably have cross links to each other in them

item.title: Seeking greenlight for SCP (a.k.a The Golden Opportunity): Re: Seeking greenlight for SCP (a.k.a The Golden Opportunity)
item.content:encoded:
If this was being done as more of a parody, I could see it. But you would need to have the kid shaken not suicidal, and maybe if the kid was a little older.

The problem is that Wonka is being presented as someone who is super freaky and creepy from the get-go, and that sets off a lot of alarms. Because the kid is being taken against his will and something is done to him that makes him suicidal, it just feels sort of cheap. If the victims weren't so young and you weren't presenting Wonka as "super-freaky" there would be less of a problem.

However, if you were presenting Wonka as more "over-zealous" and with some sort of agenda and the kid was not only older but was more of an evil kid after the experience, you may have something. Especially if the kid was more about manipulation than violence.

You just need to throw some sort of twist related to Wonka rather than just abusing some poor kid. While I don't mind seeing kids killed in horror (I blame 1980s horror movies!), my limit is seeing them hurt this specific way.

item.title: Seeking greenlight for SCP (a.k.a The Golden Opportunity): Re: Seeking greenlight for SCP (a.k.a The Golden Opportunity)
item.content:encoded:
There have been issues brought to me about copyright and trash. It is possible to switch the character name.

I'm pretty certain that just swapping out names wouldn't properly address the fact that you're still just making an overly grimdark, edgy version of Willy Wonka and his Chocolate Factory.

I'll be honest, I personally would recommend scrapping this. Not only does the core premise rely heavily on existing copyrighted work, there are also a lot of gratuitous horror elements added in seemingly just to follow said copyrighted work. I myself as a reader would downvote pretty immediately for this:

Even though Willy is super freaky and creepy, at first the child is not frightened. But when they end up back at the house, they suffer from major PTSD until they either die of stress, malnourishment, or suicide.

It seems incredibly tasteless to write about an entity preying exclusively on children, including abducting them in a traumatic process, and causing their death. Suicide and child abuse are already difficult to write tactfully; the way these plot elements have been handled currently does not convince me that the piece would be workable no matter how many edits you make to it.

I highly recommend that you write something else.

item.title: New SCP Ideas (Scylla & Charybdis): New SCP Ideas (Scylla & Charybdis)
item.content:encoded:
SCPs based off of Scylla and Charybdis from the Odyssey, and Scylla always breaches containment to get to her sister (Charybdis) in order to join her for what they call "The Great Hunt". In Scylla's Document in one of the addendums it mentions of a cross testing with SCP-914 to create a tranquilizing gas that'll make containing Scylla easier. Now for Charybdis, she is too massive to contain, so she is constantly being surveyed by the Foundation in many locations she has been sighted in. Mainly the Straight of Messina. In order to prevent any more casualties, Scylla and Charybdis must never be reunited with each other ever again no matter the cost.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up a lot of space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Articles

Elevator Pitch: Documents for newly discovered SCPs that are a threat to humankind.

Central Narrative: Two SCPs that resemble two infamous Greek monsters from the Odyssey and are running around in modern day.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Whenever Charybdis “calls out” to Scylla, Scylla breaches containment just so she can locate and find her sister so the two can go on “The Great Hunt”, as what one of Scylla’s heads exclaimed. From Scylla and Charybdis’ nature, the Foundation decided to keep the two sort from each other as much as possible.

Additional Notes: I would like feedback on containment procedures and tone.

item.title: SCP Idea: metal box, havent thought of a name yet.: SCP Idea: metal box, havent thought of a name yet.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): N/A

Page Layout (Optional): N/A

Elevator Pitch: A shiny metal box small enough to fit in the palm of someone's hand. When touched it says the name of the person that touched it, and sounds a 60 second countdown. When the countdown is finished, the victim suddenly becomes unconscious and dies.

Central Narrative: A metal box, (width: 8 cm, height: 5cm, length: 8cm) that randomly announces the name of a random person that didn't exist until their name was announced, these people will be called SCP-XXXX-1, 2, etc. If a human touches this box, it will say their full name, then proceed to sound a 60 second countdown. When the countdown stops, they will instantly become unconscious and die.

I feel like a similar SCP exists somewhere out there, and im thinking of scrapping this idea. But let me know what you think, please give criticism if you have anything to say, it would be much appreciated, thanks.

item.title: Seeking greenlight for SCP (a.k.a The Golden Opportunity): Seeking greenlight for SCP (a.k.a The Golden Opportunity)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror-ish (I guess)

Page Layout (Optional): Basic components, SCP Classification, a picture or two, containment procedures, description, possibly some test logs.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a golden ticket found in the woods. When a child picks up the ticket, it summons a decrepit and grotesque entity similar to that of Willy Wonka.

Central Narrative: Basically a Willy Wonka who lives in a factory and is summoned by a golden ticket. Small, grey, misformed figures wander around the factory with hoods. They become extremely hostile when in contact with adults. When a child is near, they express a great desire for them to meet Mr. Wonka.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Willy Wonka entity takes the child with the ticket out of the woods, and brings the kid to his factory. They enter, (and if the kid is being tracked, the signal is lost.) They are gone a day until the next morning when the child is returned to the place where they sleep. (Room, basement, bridge, etc.) Even though Willy is super freaky and creepy, at first the child is not frightened. But when they end up back at the house, they suffer from major PTSD until they either die of stress, malnourishment, or suicide. And a box of 12 pack "Augustus Flavored Chocolate" Wonka bars arrive at the sleeping place as well. (With real human DNA to that of the actor of Augustus Glute)

Additional Notes: There have been issues brought to me about copyright and trash. It is possible to switch the character name.
